profile.summary: Manba Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides financial solutions in India. The company offers new two and three-wheeler, electric two and three-wheeler, and pre-owned two-wheeler, used car, and car loans. It also provides personal and small business loans. Manba Finance Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
